about.heading: About YSR Academy
about.intro: Ysr Academy provides high-quality English language education through experienced teachers, organized courses, personalized support, and continuous student progress tracking.

cards.title: English Language Courses
cards.text: Structured programs designed to improve speaking, listening, reading, writing, grammar, vocabulary, and overall fluency.

cards.title: IELTS Preparation
cards.text: Complete IELTS preparation covering Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking with test strategies and practice exams.

cards.title: Progress Monitoring
cards.text: Regular assessments and personalized feedback help students identify weaknesses and improve their performance.

cards.title: Qualified Teachers
cards.text: Experienced English language instructors dedicated to helping every student improve and achieve their goals.

story.title: Short Brief
paragraphs: Ysr Academy is an educational center focused on helping students develop strong English language skills through structured lessons and experienced teachers.
Our programs are designed to create a comfortable and supportive learning environment where students can improve step by step and achieve measurable results.
